title: Difficult To Clean After Use
text: Difficult To Clean After Use. I used this to cook some bacon this morning. I usually just do this on parchment paper in the oven. I used this instead. I was OK, but just. The worst part was trying to get it cleaned up afterwards. I used everything in my arsenal and it was a real bear to get into all the grooves and crevices. This seemed like a valid concept, but I'm not real pleased.
